desc: Ideation complete: reduce the problem to finding the longest palindromic suffix of S.

Implement a Python program that reads S, computes the KMP prefix function for reverse(S), scans S to obtain the length L of the longest prefix of reverse(S) that is a suffix of S, then prints S + reverse(S[:len(S)-L]).
Verify sample tests and edge cases: single-character strings, strings that are already palindromes, and maximum-length inputs for performance.
